gloss: to jump out, to rush out

definitions.gloss: to jump out, to rush out
definitions.explanation: To suddenly emerge or exit quickly.
To extend outward from a surface.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{飛|と}び{出|だ}した。
examples.english: A child ran out into the road.

examples.japanese: ⟦{地震|じしん}→地震：01608_jishin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{起|お}きて→起きる：00521_okiru⟧、⟦{慌|あわ}てて→慌てる：01874_awateru⟧⟦{建物|たてもの}→建物：01458_tatemono⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{飛|と}び{出|だ}した。
examples.english: When the earthquake hit, I rushed out of the building in a panic.

examples.japanese: ⟦{釘|くぎ}→釘：03881_kugi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{飛|と}び{出|だ}している。
⟦{棚|たな}→棚：01650_tana⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{本|ほん}→本：00111_hon⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{飛|と}び{出|だ}しそうだ。
examples.english: The books look like they're about to fall off the shelf.

examples.japanese: ⟦{値段|ねだん}→値段：00871_nedan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}て→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{飛|と}び{出|だ}すほど⟦{驚|おどろ}いた→驚く：01255_odoroku⟧。
examples.english: I was so shocked by the price that my eyes nearly popped out.

notes:
{飛|と}び{出|だ}す is a compound godan verb meaning "to jump out" or "to rush out." It combines {飛|と}ぶ (to jump/fly) + {出|だ}す (to come out).

TRANSITIVITY: {自動詞|じどうし} (intransitive)

SENSE 1 - PHYSICAL MOVEMENT:
- {道|みち}に{飛|と}び{出|だ}す: to dash into the road
- {部屋|へや}から{飛|と}び{出|だ}す: to rush out of the room

SENSE 2 - PROTRUDE:
- {目|め}が{飛|と}び{出|だ}す: eyes popping out (surprise)
- {釘|くぎ}が{飛|と}び{出|だ}している: a nail is sticking out

FIGURATIVE USES:
- {家|いえ}を{飛|と}び{出|だ}す: to leave home abruptly, to run away from home

WARNING SIGN:
「{飛|と}び{出|だ}し{注意|ちゅうい}」: Watch for children/pedestrians (common road sign in Japan)
